scope: Dependency-injected, currently unmounted successor delivery router
implementation: POST boundary authenticates action.poll, accepts only four bounded resident/predecessor/checkpoint fields, uses the injected server binding store, applies no-store and rate/body limits, and returns a non-replaying non-answer delivery envelope.

verification.negative: Authentication failure, empty checkpoint, missing hash, injected binding store, and injected profile are rejected before leasing.

limitations: The factory is not mounted by production route registration until native handoff integration exists.
Authentication and lease behavior are mocked in HTTP boundary tests.
The existing keyed server's Casimir gate is not proof of deploying or executing this route.
No native client or EXE build, server restart, or live Minecraft action performed.
